# Paranjape Blue Ridge Township Ecosystem
> https://paranjapeblueridge.com

## Overview
Paranjape Blue Ridge is western Pune's premier 138-acre integrated mega-township located in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park, Pune, Maharashtra 411057. Developed by Paranjape Schemes (Construction) Ltd. (PSCL), the township is home to over 3,500 residing families and over 35,000 on-campus IT professionals.

## Master Township Scale & Geography
- Township Area: 138 Masterplanned Acres
- Developer: Paranjape Schemes (Construction) Ltd. (35+ years legacy, 200+ projects, 50,000+ happy families)
- Location: Hinjewadi Phase 1, Near Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park, Pune - 411057
- Coordinates: Latitude 18.5771° N, Longitude 73.7347° E
- Open Space: 60%+ dedicated to green fairways, riverside promenade, and gardens

## Core Township Pillars
1. Blue Ridge IT/ITES SEZ: 3+ Million Sq. Ft. operational Grade-A IT Park hosting Cognizant, Accenture, LTTS, Persistent Systems, Cisco Ecosystem. Generates 4.8% - 5.6% gross residential rental yield and enables a 0-minute walk-to-work lifestyle.
2. 9-Hole Executive Golf Course: Pune's only integrated township golf course with dedicated driving bays, putting greens, and The Cliff clubhouse.
3. Blue Ridge Public School: Fully operational ICSE-affiliated co-educational campus located inside the township perimeter with zero school commute for resident children.
4. Private Marina & River Promenade: Over 1.5 km of active waterfront along the Mula River with boating slips, kayaks, and sunset pavilions.
5. High Street Retail & Conveniences: Xion Mall, supermarkets, multiplex, polyclinics, banks, and pharmacies within walking reach.

## Transit & Connectivity Proximity
- Hinjewadi Metro Line 3 Station (Megapolis/Hinjewadi Phase 1): 800 meters (opening 2026-2027)
- Walk to Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park Gate 1 (Infosys, Wipro, TCS): 5 to 10 minutes
- Baner & Balewadi High Street: 10 minutes via the new Mahalunge-Hinjewadi bridge
- Mumbai-Pune Expressway: 5 minutes (3.5 KM)
- Pune Railway Station: 20 KM
- Pune International Airport (PNQ): 26 KM
